report.summary: 4 items from reviewed findings: fix false docstrings in drafts.py, verify compare_to_history checks truncated, locate _refuse_primary_checkout, add floor_check to ollama.run(), and check render_arms for bare by_provenance. All steps reference existing paths.
risks: compare_to_history may not exist; if it does, it might already check truncated. Need to locate first.
_refuse_primary_checkout may be defined elsewhere; if missing, must define it or fix call.
ollama.run() may never be called directly; adding floor_check could be unnecessary if session.py is the only caller.
render_arms bug may not exist if the line is not present; need to inspect full function.
todos: Search for compare_to_history definition; if found, inspect for truncated check.
Search for _refuse_primary_checkout definition; if missing, define or fix _git_in_worktree.
Search for direct calls to ollama.run() outside session.py.
Inspect full render_arms function in report.py for bare by_provenance usage.
Fix docstrings in drafts.py to accurately describe filesystem writes.
Add floor_check call in ollama.run() if direct calls exist.

items.title: Fix false docstrings in drafts.py to match actual filesystem writes
items.why_now: Misleading docstrings break developer trust and violate code-as-documentation principle.

steps.do: Update module docstring to state that set_status and apply_payload write to filesystem via write_text.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'write_text' daedalus/kairos/drafts.py confirms writes; docstring no longer claims no filesystem touch.

items.assumption: Docstring is the only place with false claims; no other misleading comments exist in the file.

items.title: Verify compare_to_history checks shape.truncated flag
items.why_now: If compare_to_history ignores truncated flag, missing fields may be silently dropped, compromising correctness of comparisons.

steps.do: Search for definition of compare_to_history in daedalus/council/canary.py or other files. If found, inspect whether it reads shape.truncated or the notes field.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'def compare_to_history' daedalus/ returns definition; visual inspection shows truncated check.

items.assumption: The function exists in the codebase; if not, the finding is moot.

items.title: Locate or implement _refuse_primary_checkout in correctness.py
items.why_now: Missing definition causes NameError at runtime, breaking safety check in _git_in_worktree.

steps.do: Search entire codebase for 'def _refuse_primary_checkout'. If not found, add the function or fix the call.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'def _refuse_primary_checkout' daedalus/ returns definition; if missing, after adding, run test to confirm no NameError.

items.assumption: The function is not defined elsewhere (e.g., imported). If imported, update import instead.

items.title: Add floor_check call in ollama.run() or document that session.py is sole entry point
items.why_now: Direct invocation of ollama.run() bypasses floor_check, potentially leaking secrets.

steps.do: Search for direct calls to ollama.run() outside session.py. If any exist, add floor_check call in ollama.run().
steps.verified_by: grep -r 'ollama\.run\|from.*ollama.*import.*run' --include='*.py' | grep -v session.py | grep -v test returns no results; if results, add floor_check and verify with test.

items.assumption: Direct calls may exist; if none, no change needed but risk is low.

items.title: Inspect render_arms for bare by_provenance variable usage
items.why_now: If by_provenance is used as bare name, NameError will crash report rendering.

steps.do: Examine the full render_arms function in daedalus/eval/report.py for any occurrence of bare 'by_provenance' (not result['by_provenance']).
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'by_provenance' daedalus/eval/report.py shows all uses; if bare name appears, fix to result['by_provenance'].

items.assumption: The line with the bug exists; if not, no change needed.
